svg.title: Colorful Europe and its landmarks → Budapest, Hungary → tiny oasis park → seated person → DNA / SNP
svg.desc: A single static vector illustration with nested geometry. Drag the map, inspect landmarks across all 49 mapped countries and territories, and zoom into the supplied golden-hour park with a seated reader. The first anatomy reveal makes the figure transparent and shows the seated organs while the camera approaches the heart. Every later level remains nested. The supplied seated geometry and proportions are preserved. Chromosomes retain the existing condensed educational representation; normal cardiac nuclei contain decondensed chromatin.
svg.metadata: Geographic boundaries: embedded Europe GeoJSON, https://github.com/leakyMirror/map-of-europe , projected using a Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection and simplified for display. The park is placed at 19.046 E, 47.507 N in Budapest, Hungary. Seated figure, Golden Hour park, and anatomical landmarks are copied from proportional_human_in_a_tiny_park_interactive_svg_code_studio.html, with uniform 100/46 scaling and the source heart centered at (554,416). Only the paired clothing-transparency/anatomy reveal fades in time; a static radial mask feathers the park edges. The heart is smooth at ordinary scale; an expanded cardiac cell clump appears at the zoom focus and fades gradually toward screen corners. Existing coronary vessels, cell organelles and molecular artwork are retained. The map is projected directly into SVG paths and landmark transforms about Budapest: the center retains its horizontal scale, upper rows narrow, and lower rows widen as it tilts. It reaches the former 2.8× center pitch of 0.42774. Hungary and the park share a daylight cream canvas. Organelle reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK26907/ . Artistic magnification is not a physical scale calibration.
